architecture.head: single affine linear regression
architecture.feature_definition: F2 = 14 acoustic + 192 embedding mean + 14 binary availability indicators
architecture.output: normalized PVQD CAPE-V severity z-score; invert with harmonization parameters

preprocessing.imputation: train-only median on trusted acoustic values
preprocessing.availability_indicators: 14 unscaled indicators appended after standardized F2; 1=available and task-trusted
preprocessing.harmonization: PVQD CAPE-V train-only mean/sd; inverse transform in weights/harmonization.json
